text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Akebono got injured, so I took her 
to the nurse's office...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, sorry, Trainer. Maybe I didn't warm 
up enough?
choice_data_list: That's not true, you did a great job.
That's not true, you did a great job.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Thank you... But please, don't make such a 
sad face, okay?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
This much is easy-peasy! Chanko nabe 
always keeps me full of energy~☆ So, see?!
choice_data_list: Even so, I want you to rest.
You're not overdoing it, are you?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, you're worried about me, aren't 
you? Yeah, got it!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Alright, let's go eat some chanko nabe! I 
feel like eating together will help you 
get better in no time☆

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I made sure Hishi Akebono got plenty of 
rest today to prepare for our next 
training session...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
...Ehehe, I guess I strained myself a 
little too much~...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She really wasn't in good shape... After 
treating her that day, I decided to let 
her rest from training...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
"Watch this~! My lower body strength from 
all those shiko stomps isn't just for 
show~!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After receiving treatment, Hishi Akebono 
cheerfully resumed her training.
